spec.name: GoldVWAPMeanReversionSession
spec.hypothesis: During London and NY sessions, XAUUSD exhibits strong mean-reverting behavior around the Session VWAP due to institutional execution algorithms targeting volume-weighted fair value. When price extends too far from VWAP (measured in ATR units) during active hours, liquidity providers fade the move expecting reversion. The losing side is typically retail momentum traders chasing breakouts that lack institutional order flow support, or late-entry HFTs overextending positions before session resets.
spec.entry_logic: Enter long when close is below VWAP by more than entry_threshold * ATR AND RSI < oversold level during London/NY session. Enter short when close is above VWAP by more than entry_threshold * ATR AND RSI > overbought level during London/NY session. Requires confirmed bar close.
spec.exit_logic: Stop loss at sl_mult * ATR from entry price (positive USD distance). Take profit at tp_mult * ATR from entry price (positive USD distance), ensuring minimum 1.50 USD points.
spec.expected_failure_conditions: Strong unidirectional trend days where VWAP becomes a trending anchor rather than mean-reversion target; low-volatility Asian session bleed into London open causing false extensions
